whyThisMatters: These aren't just buzzwords — knowing what phishing, MFA, or ransomware actually mean is what lets you recognize the real thing the moment it shows up in your inbox or on your screen.
rememberThis: You don't need to memorize a glossary — just enough of these words to recognize the real thing when it shows up.

discussionPrompts: Ask which term people knew the clue for but blanked on the exact word — vocabulary gaps are worth naming out loud.
Ask if anyone can explain the difference between malware, ransomware, and a trojan without looking at the clues.
Ask which of these terms actually shows up in their day-to-day work versus which ones are just "good to know."
facilitatorNotes.commonWrongAnswer: PRETEXTING is the term people most often can't recall or confuse with phishing/social engineering generally — it's the least everyday word in the list.
